title: Trip Date Chain
summary: Lines up hotel nights under the flights and catches a stay booked for the wrong night, like a room from the date of a 00:50 landing.
description: Night-by-night strip of stays under flights that catches a small-hours landing with the room booked from that date, nights paid before a +1 arrival, gap nights, double-booked nights and a room kept past a small-hours departure, with one-tap fixes and Undo.
catches: Room booked from the date of a small-hours arrival (needs the night before)
Room kept past a small-hours departure
limits: Times are local wall-clock times as printed; add IANA zones for real durations
Reads only the legs and stays you pass
a11y: Visual strip is aria-hidden; every finding is also text
Fix and Undo are labelled buttons; outcome via role=status
Focus moves to the next fix after one is applied
stops: Hotel booked for the wrong night
mistakes: landed after midnight no hotel room
hotel booked a day late after overnight flight
